sentences.text: Researchers conducted a prospective study comparing people diagnosed with Parkinson disease to control patients who had surgery on their submandibular glands for other reasons, using a method called RT-QuIC to find alpha-synuclein clumps in fresh tissue samples taken from the submandibular gland.
The authors note that their results need to be confirmed by testing larger groups of people before the method can be fully trusted.
